name: OmniVoice
access: Hugging Face weights k2-fsa/OmniVoice (about 0.6B parameters; based on Qwen3-0.6B) and the k2-fsa/OmniVoice repository

voice.input_audio: Text with optional non-verbal tags; an optional `instruct` string of speaker attributes; or a reference clip for cloning [gh-omnivoice] [gh-omnivoice-vd]
voice.output_audio: Audio returned by the Python package; the pages read state no sample rate [gh-omnivoice]
voice.voices: voice design from a fixed attribute vocabulary; custom cloning from a clip [gh-omnivoice-vd]
languages: More than 600 languages; a full list is in the repository [gh-omnivoice]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: The README states a real-time factor as low as 0.025, about 40 times faster than real time, without naming the hardware [gh-omnivoice]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, no price. The code is Apache-2.0, but the model card says the pretrained model is licensed CC BY-NC because of its training data, so the weights are for non-commercial use [hf-omnivoice]. The README lists CUDA, Apple Silicon and Intel Arc GPU routes and gives no memory figure; it was tested on Intel Arc cards with 4 GB and 16 GB [gh-omnivoice]
